Card Q&A.q: If one of the cards revealed from my deck by this card's [On Play] [When Digivolving] effect is a Tamer card with the [D-Brigade] or [DigiPolice] trait and a play cost of 4 or less, can I play that card?

Effect: [On Play][When Digivolving] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. You may play 1 card with the [D-Brigade] or [DigiPolice] trait and a play cost of 4 or less among them without paying the cost. Trash the rest.
Inherited Effect: [All Turns][Once Per Turn] When one of your other Digimon is deleted, reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. You may play 1 [Commandramon] among them without paying the cost. Trash the rest.
Notes: 2024 Championship Regionals Participation Card Set Wave 1
